title: profiles/ci/auth.yaml
content:
auth:
  defaults:
    identity: github-oidc  # Set default identity for CI
  identities:
    github-oidc:
      kind: aws/role
      via:
        provider: aws-oidc
        audience: sts.amazonaws.com
      principal:
        role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/GitHubActionsRole
